notes: Strict Rully AOC specifications. Current INAO records confirm the AOP, red/white production, and 23 Premier Cru climats. The homologated 2011 cahier is the direct production-rule authority. Red accessory Chardonnay and Pinot Gris are vineyard co-planting exceptions and are not promoted as ordinary cellar-blend choices.
